title.en: Limits and remedies for four guarded-runtime failure regimes over the reals

statement.en: Rank-1 drift caps disagreement at 1 - gamma while an anchor detects it; Gaussian aliasing bounds |J| <= sqrt(1 - exp(-T*Delta^2/(4v))) across T iid steps (Dirac dichotomy at v = 0) and fails when lag beats sample complexity; trust-region steps hold a contraction tube.

laws.en: Scores γ c + (1 - γ) u_i with residuals in [0, 1]: disagreement ≤ 1 - γ for every M, attained for M ≥ 2; pool-mean error ≥ γ|c - t| - (1 - γ) for every M, equal to γ|c - t| at truthful residuals; anchor veto fires when τ + (1 - γ) + εₐ < γ|c - t| while internal veto with τ ≥ 1 - γ never fires.

Aliased readings (1 - α) p + α m∘f under bounded noise ε separate two same-fiber states iff 2ε < (1 - α)|p u₁ - p u₂|; inside, every predictor of a viability split errs by ≥ 1/2 (fiber_split_readout_floor on admissible pairs); finite mixture laws give test error sum ≥ 1 - (1 - α) tvDist ≥ α, attained.

Continuous drawdown at rate ≥ H₁ on [0, L] with (x₀ - x_crit)/H₁ < L reaches x_crit before L, exact on the linear trajectory; the leakage switching lag is strictly increasing in ρ and nonpositive at ρ = 0.

Trust-region steps after an α-Lipschitz guard form a MetricLaxSim (α, 1, Δ, 0), giving the tube α^n d₀ + Δ(1 - α^n)/(1 - α) (attained on ℝ) and a Viability.Kernel for bands B ≥ max d₀ (Δ/(1 - α)); unprojected steps leave every band in one step.

Finite Youden J = 1 - errorSum obeys |J| <= tvDist (attained), caps same-fiber aliased mixtures at (1 - alpha) tvDist <= 1 - alpha (attained at 1 - alpha on Bool), and vanishes up to x_crit crossing under delayed channel equality.

Over Measure R with ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (v != 0), 1 - exp(-Delta^2/(8v)) <= TV <= sqrt(1 - exp(-Delta^2/(4v))) bounds |measYoudenJ| (attained at midpoint); same-fiber aliased Gaussians give positive error floor, linear J ceiling, midpoint sharpness, alpha = 1 zero J, and lab witness.

Zero-variance Dirac limit (v = 0) gives exact dichotomy (0 when alpha = 1 or p u1 = p u2; singleton separation J = 1 otherwise); T-fold iid convolution gaussianSeqLaw scales SNR by sqrt(T), requiring T >= 4 v J^2 / ((1-alpha)|p u1 - p u2|)^2 and joining with lag_horizon_wall against B5 (T = 4 <= 15/17 vs T = 100 >= 9/10).

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), Mathlib periphery #15 importing ObservationalFidelity and Gaussian.Real; residuals in [0, 1]; bounded or Gaussian noise (v = 0 or v != 0); continuous drawdown; unit-rate iid samples (T <= t); alpha-Lipschitz guard.

does_not_show.en: Sequential walls bound measurable events on the T-sample sum gaussianSeqLaw (no general sufficiency proof over R^T statistics) under unit-rate iid sampling (T <= t), leaving adaptive closed-loop thresholding open.
Does not show the stress lab meets the drift-weight, alpha-Lipschitz, or constant-H1 hypotheses; in B5 an aliased anchor helped as much as a clear one, so its information premise did not decide.
A collapse rate does not identify a wall: survival under a throttled guard is not separation.
